tagline: Furniture and metalwork plans for first-time builders
brief: A planner for people who have never built furniture. Pick a template, set your sizes, and get a 3D preview, a cut plan and build steps. The name and mark should calm the beginner's fear of ruining material.
criteria: Success: reads as a 1 cut through a board, holds at 16 px and in one colour, and works for wood and metal.

concepts.name: Cut Once
concepts.idea: One board, one saw cut, and the cut is the numeral 1.
rationale: Says the name without a saw blade or wood grain, so it also fits metalwork
The kerf is the app's own vocabulary: the gap every cut plan accounts for
Keeps the app's ballpoint blue and highlighter yellow, so it belongs to the notebook

recommendation: Cut Once: one idea, explained in one sentence, that holds from a 16 px browser tab to a printed sign.
next_steps: Run a professional trademark search on the name and the mark
Replace the name and icons in the web and iOS apps
